title: deparia sikkimensis
intro: Deparia sikkimensis, commonly known as Sikkim goldback fern, is a species of fern in the family Woodsiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, where it is valued for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The health benefits of Deparia sikkimensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and inhibiting cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of Deparia sikkimensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
